g.text: Nearby — Sequence Diagram: Registration, Sign-in and Access Tokens
[a code was sent less than a minute ago]
refuses or does not answer; console in development
create(hash, channel, provider request id, expires in 10 min)
202 — same answer for a registered phone
[no code, expired, used or 3 failed attempts]
markUsed — false if another request used it first
create(pending account) — or reuse the pending one
delete — the number can start again
— a stand-in hash for an unknown phone
saveLockout — the 5th failure in 15 min locks for 15 min
401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS — the same answer every time
saveLockout(no failures) — only after earlier failures
verify Google ID token — Google's keys, our client ids
[invalid token, not linked or not active]
[an active account and no code in the last minute]
reset code, sent in the background as in Register
202 — the same answer for any phone
check the latest reset code, as in Verify
key by kid; HS256 only; signature;
iss, aud, typ at+jwt; not expired;
Errors: AuthService throws a DomainError with a code; ApiExceptionFilter (api) turns it into the status shown.
Token: header {alg HS256, kid, typ at+jwt}; claims sub, role (guest, registrant, user, admin), sid (accounts only), iss/aud nearby-api, iat, exp.
Limits: register, verify, sign-in, Google and both reset calls allow 20 requests a minute per IP each (429 RATE_LIMITED).
Planned, not shown: refresh tokens and a revocation check by sid (SEC-005), audit records (SEC-004).
